news_1.title: NASA Confirms Discovery of Water Ice Deposits in Lunar South Pole Craters
news_1.summary: Spectral measurements from the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter confirm stable deposits of surface water ice in permanently shadowed regions of Shackleton Crater.
news_1.claimText: NASA confirmed substantial water ice deposits in permanently shadowed regions of the Moon's south pole via Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter data.

news_3.title: Breakthrough in Solid-State Lithium Battery Doubles EV Range to 1,000 Kilometers
news_3.summary: Researchers demonstrate an inorganic solid electrolyte capable of preventing dendrite formation across 1,000 fast-charging cycles at room temperature.
news_3.claimText: MIT researchers developed a solid-state battery architecture that achieves over 1,000 charge cycles without degradation, potentially doubling EV range.
